insights.summary: Customers find it difficult to locate important payment information but acknowledge that FlowPay eases payment tracking.
evidence: Important payment information is difficult to find.
FlowPay makes payment tracking much easier.
insights.recommended_action: Improve the UI and navigation to make important payment information more accessible and prominently displayed.

insights.summary: Customers request the ability to export invoices in various formats (Excel, PDF, CSV) and support for bulk downloads to improve accounting efficiency.
evidence: Please add an option to export invoices to Excel.
We need bulk invoice downloads for accounting.
Invoice export would save our finance team several hours.
insights.recommended_action: Develop and release features to allow invoice export in Excel, PDF, and CSV formats with bulk download capabilities.

insights.summary: Many customers report the mobile app is slow and unstable, including freezing during transaction history scrolling, unexpected sign-outs, and general sluggishness.
evidence: Transaction history freezes when I scroll.
The app keeps signing me out.
The latest version feels slower than the previous one.
The mobile application has become very slow.
insights.recommended_action: Investigate and optimize the mobile app's performance and stability focusing on scrolling, session management, and overall speed improvements.

insights.summary: Users experience severe issues with payments failing post-OTP entry, double charges, app crashes during payments, login failures, missing OTP codes, slow checkouts, and deducted amounts without order confirmation.
evidence: My payment failed after I entered the OTP.
I was charged twice for the same transaction.
Checkout keeps loading and the payment never completes.
The amount was deducted but the order was not confirmed.
insights.recommended_action: Initiate an urgent investigation into payment processing and authentication workflows; fix bugs causing transaction failures, duplicate charges, login and OTP delivery issues immediately.

insights.summary: Customers report long delays in receiving refunds, unclear refund status, and lack of visibility into refund processing timelines.
evidence: Support confirmed a refund but I have not received it.
My refund has not arrived after ten days.
The refund status has been pending for a week.
insights.recommended_action: Enhance refund processing reliability and provide clear, real-time refund status updates to customers to reduce uncertainty and delays.

insights.summary: Mixed feedback on dashboard usability: some find it clean and helpful, others report confusing navigation, slow loading, and desire for customizable dashboard widgets and clearer analytic filters.
evidence: The analytics screen needs clearer filters.
Please allow us to customize dashboard widgets.
The dashboard takes too long to load.
The new dashboard is clean and helpful.
The dashboard navigation is confusing.
insights.recommended_action: Improve dashboard navigation, speed up loading times, and add options for widget customization and clearer filter controls for analytics.

insights.summary: Customers express satisfaction with the prompt resolution of their problems by customer support.
evidence: Customer support resolved my problem quickly.
insights.recommended_action: Continue maintaining strong customer support responsiveness and possibly highlight support successes in communications.

insights.summary: Customers seek integrations with accounting software, CRM platforms, and APIs to simplify workflows and support transaction reconciliation.
evidence: Please add an integration with our accounting software.
We would like API support for transaction reconciliation.
Please connect FlowPay with more CRM platforms.
insights.recommended_action: Prioritize development of integrations with popular accounting software, CRM systems, and provide robust API support for transaction reconciliation.
